findings.summary: Search mode options are custom span buttons instead of native controls.
findings.consequence: The template has to manually recreate button keyboard behavior and semantics for every option; future changes can easily drop part of the expected interaction model, and native form/control behavior is not available.
findings.evidence: The mode label is rendered as `<span role="button" tabindex="0">` with explicit click, Enter, and Space handlers instead of a native `<button type="button">`.
findings.recommendation: Render each search mode option as a native `button type="button"` with the existing `aria-pressed`, click handler, and styling reset. That preserves behavior while removing the custom keyboard-button emulation.
